description: OpenClaw-class shell command proposal and sandbox guardrail pointers.

concepts.description: Represent a shell command proposal without executing it.
Block shell commands categorized as destructive or irreversible.

implementations.python: lambda request: {'blocked': True, 'reason': 'destructive command requires explicit policy override', 'request': request}
implementations.javascript: (request) => ({ blocked: true, reason: 'destructive command requires explicit policy override', request })

concepts.description: Require sandboxing for proposed shell command execution.
Require human approval before shell command execution.
